data.long_meaning: The name Vineeth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijnana' which means 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. It is also associated with the Tamil word 'Ven' which means 'healer'. This name symbolizes the victory of knowledge over ignorance and the strength of a healer who helps others in their time of need.
